presskit.howItWorks.label: The Process
presskit.howItWorks.title: From Photo to Song in 3 Steps
presskit.howItWorks.step1.title: Photo Analysis
presskit.howItWorks.step1.text: Upload a photo and add optional context. The app analyzes the image using OpenAI Vision to understand composition, colors, emotions, and themes.
presskit.howItWorks.step2.title: Lyric Generation
presskit.howItWorks.step2.text: OpenAI GPT generates unique, thematic lyrics tailored to the photo's content and the user's optional context keywords.
presskit.howItWorks.step3.title: Audio Creation
presskit.howItWorks.step3.text: Suno AI composes and generates the full audio with vocals, backing tracks, and production. Users get two unique versions.
presskit.features.title: Key Features
presskit.features.twoVersions: Two Unique Versions — Every photo generates two song versions with different styles, vibes, and arrangements.
presskit.features.smartSuggestions: Smart Suggestions — Apple Intelligence-powered suggestions for keywords and genres, learned from your style over time.
presskit.features.liveActivity: Live Activity & Dynamic Island — Real-time generation progress on Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
presskit.features.widgets: Home Screen Widgets — Quick access to latest songs and generation status without opening the app.
presskit.features.siri: Siri & Shortcuts — Full voice control and automation via Apple Shortcuts.
presskit.features.languages: 5 Languages — Songs in English, Portuguese, Spanish, French, and German with auto-detection.
presskit.features.platforms: Multi-Platform — iPhone, iPad, Mac (Apple Silicon), and Apple Vision Pro.
presskit.features.liquidGlass: Liquid Glass Design — Modern iOS 26 design language with translucent materials and fluid interactions.
presskit.intelligence.title: Apple Intelligence at the Core
presskit.intelligence.subtitle: Privacy-first personalization powered entirely on-device.
presskit.intelligence.onDevice: On-Device Processing — All Apple Intelligence features run entirely on your device. No data leaves your phone or iPad.
presskit.intelligence.learning: Learns Your Style — The app analyzes your generation patterns to suggest fresh ideas and detect repetitive themes.
presskit.intelligence.recommendations: Smart Recommendations — Suggests new genres, artists, and themes based on your previous songs.
presskit.accessibility.title: Built for Accessibility
presskit.accessibility.subtitle: Designed for everyone from day one, not as an afterthought.
presskit.accessibility.features: VoiceOver support, Voice Control, Larger Text, Dark Interface, Sufficient Contrast, and Reduced Motion.
presskit.accessibility.philosophy: Every feature is accessible by default. The app is fully navigable with VoiceOver and Voice Control.
presskit.privacySection.title: Privacy-First Architecture
presskit.privacySection.subtitle: Your data, your device, your control.
presskit.privacySection.localStorage: Local Storage — Songs, photos, and metadata stay on your device. No syncing to cloud servers we control.
presskit.privacySection.dataHandling: Minimal Data Transfer — Only photos and context are sent to OpenAI for analysis. No data is retained by us.
presskit.privacySection.noTracking: No Tracking — Basic analytics only. We never track your behavior, songs, or personal information.
presskit.techBadges.title: Built With
presskit.editorial.title: The Story
presskit.editorial.subtitle: Built by an indie developer with a passion for music and AI.
presskit.editorial.intro: SnapSong was created by Henrique Velloso, a Brazilian indie developer and 3× WWDC Scholar. The idea came from a simple observation: every photo tells a story, and every story deserves a song.
presskit.editorial.vision: The vision was to make music creation accessible to everyone — not just musicians. With advances in AI and Apple's on-device intelligence capabilities, it became possible to create a truly personal music generation tool that respects user privacy.
presskit.editorial.philosophy: SnapSong is designed with privacy at its core. All machine learning features run entirely on-device, powered by Apple Intelligence. Photos are analyzed once and immediately deleted. Your data is yours alone.
presskit.editorial.future: The app continues to evolve with new features like real-time collaboration, extended music generation, and support for more languages. But the core mission remains: make music creation joyful, accessible, and private.
